disease.description: A form of progressive myoclonic epilepsy, a clinically and genetically heterogeneous group of disorders defined by the combination of action and reflex myoclonus, other types of epileptic seizures, and progressive neurodegeneration and neurocognitive impairment. EPM4 is an autosomal recessive form associated with renal failure in some cases. Cognitive function is preserved.
